Göztepe Spor Kulübü, commonly referred to as Göztepe, is a Turkish multi-sport club based in the Göztepe and Güzelyalı neighborhoods of İzmir. Founded on 14 June 1925 as Göztepe Gençlik Kulübü, it is one of the oldest sports institutions in Turkey with a rich history spanning over a century.
